title: Crown of Midnight
author: Sarah J. Maas
summary: The second Throne of Glass novel. Having won her place as the king's Champion, a young assassin is sent out to eliminate his enemies, while deadly secrets surround her in the glass castle.
readIf: you want a fast fantasy that adds mystery and romance to an assassin story.
skipIf: you have not read Throne of Glass, since the first book sets up all the people here.

pairings.reason: The first book in the series, where the heroine and her place at court begin.
Another young-adult fantasy built on a young woman with unusual power and a court that wants to use it.
A more melancholy tale of a young killer in royal service, written with great emotional depth.
